stepTitle: Derive the equation of the decision boundary using a probability threshold of $$0.5$$. Express your answer in terms of $$X_1$$ and $$X_2$$
stepBody:
You build a logistic regression model using $$X_1$$ and $$X_2$$ to predict whether a student prefers Kendrick, coded as $$y_i=1, $$ or Drake, coded as $$y_i=0$$
The model uses the following parameter vector
$$	heta=(-2, 2, 1)$$
and follows the standard logistic regression form.
You may rearrange the equation so that constants are on either side.
